exposure_policy: TUNE PUBLIC for development decisions; CAL PUBLIC held from candidate predictions until separate frozen calibration registration. Same writer sees both, so this is exposure bookkeeping, not independent split qualification.
lineage_policy: All candidate-writer-G0 source/writer cohorts connect TRAIN/TUNE/CAL into one component; no grouped uncertainty or independent generation credit.
source_policy: Original Catalog-guided fictional situations; no external/private/production/AS/TEST source, recycled TRAIN/error text, automated translation/synonym/template filling.
first_slice_selection: First formal Topic in each of18 domains by pinned Catalog order, not error ranking

split_assignments.requirement: Three originally authored situations with current goal/object evidence; preserve uncertainty and nearby excluded-label questions for review. Distinct IDs do not prove semantic independence.
